answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bond plus a rotating jury. Each identity must post a horizon stake before its answer counts, and a panel drawn from the nebula pool is revealed only after the epoch seed rotates, so a farm cannot pre-target its graders. Every sealed score is opened together at close, and one wallet nullifier collapses linked keys into a single trellis seat, so N fake identities pay N stakes for one emission share. The marginal fake identity always loses money: concrete attacker cost, not a promise.
